en.headline: Australian man arrested over imitation pistol in Yau Ma Tei
en.dek: Police seized a suspected replica Mauser pistol after a report near a Temple Street bar on Wednesday night and held a 46-year-old man for possessing an imitation firearm.
body: A 46-year-old Australian man was arrested on Wednesday night in Yau Ma Tei on suspicion of possessing an imitation firearm after police recovered a suspected replica Mauser pistol. Officers in protective gear, including members of the Counter Terrorism Response Unit and Emergency Unit, sealed building entrances around Temple Street after a report at about 10pm.

Police said the man was stopped near a staircase of a tenement next to a bar in the Temple Street area. Reports said bar staff had earlier seen him carrying an object resembling a pistol while drinking and followed him before calling police. He was taken away with his head covered.

The object recovered was described as an imitation pistol rather than a live firearm. Police have not announced further charges. Temple Street and nearby Shanghai Street were briefly locked down while officers searched the building.

zh.headline: 油麻地檢獲仿製曲尺手槍 拘捕澳洲籍男子
zh.dek: 周三晚約十時廟街酒吧一帶有人報稱懷疑有人藏有手槍物體，警方檢獲仿製曲尺手槍，以涉嫌管有仿製槍械拘捕46歲澳洲籍男子。
body: 警方周三晚上在油麻地拘捕一名46歲澳洲籍男子，涉嫌管有仿製槍械，並檢獲一支懷疑仿製曲尺手槍。晚上約十時接報後，反恐特勤隊及衝鋒隊等人員穿防護裝備到場，封鎖廟街一帶唐樓出入口。
男子在酒吧附近唐樓樓梯口被截獲。有報道指酒吧職員較早前見到他身上有懷疑手槍物體，跟蹤至附近後報案。他其後蒙頭被帶上警車。
檢獲物品被形容為仿製手槍，並非實彈槍械。警方尚未公布其他控罪。調查期間廟街及附近上海街一度封鎖，警員登樓搜查。
